data.desc: SenesTech, Inc. (NASDAQ: SNES) is advancing the future of rodent control and integrated pest management (IPM). Its products deliver long-term control of rodent populations by limiting reproduction, complementing the sanitation, exclusion, monitoring and targeted removal tools that make up modern IPM programs, as regulations and customer expectations move the industry toward more responsible approaches. The Company serves consumer and professional markets through Evolve, an easy-to-use soft bait, and ContraPest, a liquid formulation for professional pest management, along with assessment and monitoring services that help customers measure results.
